remarks: Move Right in to this impeccably Updated 2 Bed, 2 Bath, End Unit Condo.This condo is in a fabulous complex in Wilton, it has a Pool and a tennis court. Included Is spacious Eat-In Kitchen with Granite Counter Top and Stainless Steel Appliances. Master Bedroom with a dressing room and a standing shower.  The Condo also has Wooden Floors, a Fireplace and a private deck. It's perfectly located to the Merritt Pkwy and all other shopping needs.  2 Month Security Deposit+ 1 month Rent and Good Credit needed.
